description: This file contains transformation logic for converting OpenAI embeddings request/response formats into AWS Bedrock Amazon Titan V2 /invoke format. It defines a configuration class and methods to map parameters and transform responses.

classes.name: AmazonTitanV2Config
classes.description: Class responsible for configuration parameters for the Amazon Titan V2 embedding transformation, including methods for parameter mapping and response transformation.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns the current configuration as a dictionary of non-None class attributes.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameter names supported for mapping in this transformer.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params(self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to AWS-specific inference parameters, especially handling encoding formats.

methods.name: AmazonTitanV2EmbeddingRequest _transform_request(self, input: str, inference_params: dict)
methods.description: Transforms an input string and inference parameters into an AmazonTitanV2EmbeddingRequest object.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response(self, response_list: List[dict], model: str)
methods.description: Transforms a list of response dictionaries into an EmbeddingResponse object, extracting embedding data accordingly.

methods.name: None __init__(self, normalize: Optional[bool] = None, dimensions: Optional[int] = None)
